notes.title: Endless Mode Update
notes.content:
You asked for it, now it's here (fashionably late)!
In this update:
[list]
[*]Added endless mode (unbalanced beyond reason, great for messing around)
[*]Buffed machine gun (will it finally find love?)
[*]Added upgrade tracker
[*]New [strike]rat[/strike] effect (try beating a non-endless run with the carver :D)
[*]Small bug fixes and qol changes
[/list]

Sorry that this update took so long to come out, college applications/results and senioritis have been bogging me down. I didn't get as much time to test this, so if you encounter any bugs feel free to create a discussion or email me about it at dementedfishhelp@gmail.com
In other news, we're almost at $400 for Charity Gaming! Consider gifting the game, it's what the peanut butter wants. Disobey, and a disaster may befall you that leaves you quivering in fear every time you see a jar.

notes.title: Download Milestone Reached and Soundtrack Now on Spotify
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone that purchased the game! Together, we've raised over $250 for Charity Gaming! (donated in $50 increments to prevent confusion on my end)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809060/a26a5972d7b7d6ddfac66ee52b250da80b6ad1e6.jpg[/img]

A special thanks to AstralSpiff and his community, as well as all of the other people who have made content about the game. Your support has made this positive change a reality.

In other news, the Official Soundtrack, "Churnin' the Night Away", is now live on Spotify. No longer will your [strike]nutting [/strike]listening be restricted to only in game! Critics have called it "Who are you" and "How did you get in my house", which is short for "Wow this sounds really good, also is that a rat playing the guitar? How cool".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809060/3ea4e83bc8e6bf0bdc0a88b6c6b676ea477d8610.png[/img]

On a personal note, I would like to thank everyone for all the positivity and support they've given, especially seeing as this is my first game. It means a lot to me and I still can't believe it all happened. Let's aim for $500 next!

Stay nutty,
Demented Fish Studios
